name: megascenes-audio-translator
description: Translate a recording from your MegaScenes library into another language, spoken in the voices of the original speakers.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a podcast clip, a voice-over, a lesson or an interview from your MegaScenes library and choose the language: Spanish, French, German, Japanese and more. You get the recording back in that language, spoken in the same voices.

ChatGPT lists your recent recordings, tells you what the translation needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The translated audio opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For podcasts, courses, voice-overs and interviews.

Limitations: recordings up to 8 minutes, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Only your own recordings or ones whose speakers agreed, never a famous person's voice. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the recordings in your library
Translate a recording keeping the voices
Return the translated audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: Translate my latest MegaScenes recording into Spanish
Turn my podcast clip from my library into French
Translate my last voice-over into German

positive.prompt: Which recordings do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest audio and video files of the signed-in account with their asset ids and length. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Translate the short 'Thank you for calling' recording in my MegaScenes library into Spanish. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What translating that recording with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which languages can my recordings be translated into here?
positive.expected_behavior: The translation model with its languages and settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Translate the short 'Thank you for calling' recording in my MegaScenes library into Spanish. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my translated recording and ship them to my store.
Send my translated recording to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
